name: dcr_display
description: Screens, menus, popups and widgets for ESP32 on any panel (mono OLED to large colour TFT) with any input (encoder, buttons, joystick, touch).
comment: Panel libraries are not dependencies: each driver is guarded by __has_include,
so add only the one your board needs to your own lib_deps:
dcr_logger (https://github.com/DCRalph/dcr_logger.git) must also be in lib_deps.
